title: Wire remote pinning into transit pipeline drain task
description:
What: After run_pipeline() succeeds in main.rs drain task, insert a remote_pin_jobs row for each configured external service whose group patterns match.

Algorithm:
1. In crates/transit/src/main.rs:
   a. After config loading, build RemotePinClient instances for each external service in config.pinning.external_services (skip if list is empty)
   b. Spawn run_remote_pin_worker() as a background tokio task
   c. In the pipeline drain task, after run_pipeline() returns Ok((result, _)):
      for each external_service in config.pinning.external_services {
        if group_matches(result.groups, &external_service.groups) {
          INSERT OR IGNORE INTO remote_pin_jobs (cid, service_name, status, attempt_count) VALUES (?, ?, 'pending', 0)
          log debug: cid enqueued for external service
        }
      }

2. group_matches(article_groups: &[String], patterns: &[String]) -> bool:
   - if patterns is empty: return true (all groups)
   - for each group in article_groups:
     - for each pattern in patterns:
       - if pattern == group or pattern ends with '.*' and group starts with prefix: return true
   - return false

3. Use the transit pool for INSERT (same pool passed to run_remote_pin_worker)

Defensive programming:
- INSERT OR IGNORE: if the same (cid, service) is already in the table, don't fail
- If DB insert fails: log warning, continue (best-effort, don't fail pipeline)
- The drain task must not block on external service calls — only on DB insert
